remarks: Enjoy the best of both worlds: just one mile from downtown, yet tucked into a peaceful neighborhood that offers a more relaxed way of life. Ideally located between Routes 15 and I-95, this lovingly cared-for 2-bedroom, 2-full-bathroom home features a large, open-concept living and dining area with sliders leading to an oversized, private deck-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Within walking distance of downtown and shopping centers, and just steps from Scalzi Park, offering pickleball and tennis courts, playgrounds, walking trails, climbing areas, a concrete skate area, sports fields, and more. A golf course is also conveniently located at the end of the street.  The only unit in the complex with two reserved parking spaces, this home also features lifetime warranty windows and patio doors, thoughtfully updated appliances, and generous storage, including carport and basement spaces within the building. A home that's been truly loved, in a location that makes everyday living effortless.
